text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Mejiro Palmer hasn't been feeling well
lately, so
the two of us decide to pray at
a shrine.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
...Anyway, that's what I wished for. Do
you think
it's okay to ask for that?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
I mean, it's not like we're super tight
with the
gods or anything, right?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
We basically only ever drop by to say hi
when
we're in trouble and need a favor
or something.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
So I'd like to do something nice for them
in
return. I wonder what kinda good
deeds I can do.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Oh! Look, there's a bunch of a bamboo
brooms
over there!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
You think I can rack up some divine
brownie
points if I sweep up the place?
It's basically the
same as helping out
with house chores, yeah?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
All right! Let's clean this place up so
good, the
gods will be shooketh when
they see it!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
And so, Mejiro Palmer and I clean the
shrine
grounds from top to bottom.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
There! This place is clean as a whistle! I
bet it'll be
okay if I ask upstairs for a
favor now!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Okay, here I go. Ahem... Please hear my
wish.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Whew... Going on that cleaning spree
cleared out
the cobwebs in my head too.
It's like a weight's
been taken off me.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
I feel so invigorated, and, like... I guess
free and
light?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Omigosh, wait. Could it be the gods
blessed me
already?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
...Thanks, gods! Watch my next race,
'kay?!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
It's a relief to see Mejiro Palmer looking
bright
and energetic again. I silently
thank the gods as
well.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
After all this cleaning, surely the gods'll
help
grant my wi—

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Just then, a strong gust of wind sweeps
through
the area and scatters all the
leaves and trash we
just swept up all
over the grounds again.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Oh. Em. GEE! Are you for real right
now?!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
We'd better get this cleaned up, quick!
Um,
where'd that broom go?!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Even asking the gods for help doesn't
come
easy... In the end, Mejiro Palmer's
condition fails
to improve.
